week34.0: Aqcic, yeqqnen ɣef wakken ur yelli ara umkan, s umata yeǧǧa iḍaren-is ttwaɣellten ɣer uɣerfan mi ara yettkemmil armud s wudem imatu.
week34.3: Ɣas akken umkan yenqes, armud n uqcic d ubeddel n wudem n uḍfel-ik zemren ad qqimen d ayen yettwaḥessen.
week34.4: Ad tkemmleḍ ad tḥessed i wuṭṭun n armud n uqcic yezga d ayen yelhan armi d tlalit.

week35.0: Aqcic yettkemmil ad yettaru azal, ayen ara t-yeɛawen ad yessuter asemmaḍ-is mi ara d-yili. Umkan yettilin deg taddart n tkuffa yettuɣal d amecṭuḥ ugar.
week35.3: Ahettu ameqqran n ukalas izmer ad d-yili ticki aqcic yettekkes cwiṭ cwiṭ.
week35.4: Ɣas akken umkan yeqqnen, aqcic ilaq ad yettkemmil armud s wudem imatu am ddasen iɛeddan.

week36.0: Idamen sεan tazmert n uddurar n yiman-is s umata, yerna aqcic izmer ad yettwaḥaddu ad yettawi.
week36.3: Tzemreḍ ad tḥessed kra n tikkal d anfas amecṭuḥ, acku taddart n tkuffa tettawi aṭas n umkan deg wadda n iɣsan.
week36.4: Lḥemla tettwaḥseb d tummidt gar ddasen 37 ɣer 42.

week37.0: Aqcic ittwaḥseb d ayen yewjed ad yettwaleḍ. Tuget n yiqcicen yezga qqnen s uqerru ɣer wadda.
week37.3: Ahettu n ukayad deg ukalas d ayen imatu ticki aqcic yeqqen deg ukalas.
week37.4: Seg ddasen-a, ittwaḥseb belli lḥemla tewjed, yerna tlalit tezmer ad d-teḍru ula d anwa wass.

week38.0: Aqucuy ameẓyan i yeggugen aglim yeqqnen yakan, yerna iɣsan ttnumuyen meconium, amazrar amezwaru n uqcic.
week38.3: Ssen tilɣa n tlalit yezmer ad yelhu ticki yeqreb wass n tlalit.
week38.4: Tlalit i yettuheyyin, ma yella war lemɛna n ṭṭbib, ur tettwaqnaɛ ara s umata send ddasen 39.

week39.0: Aglim, yettuɣalen d arqaq send, yettuɣal d aɣelnaw yerna yettwaḥrez aqcic ugar. Aɣecc ameẓyan, vernix, daɣen ittɛawan ɣer tuffɣa deg tlalit.
week39.3: Tuffɣa n usbar d tmerrit ur d-yettwaḥessen ara aṭas ttilint ticki tqeṛṛeb ass n tlalit.
week39.4: Askaddab n idammen n uqcic yettkemmil deffir tlalit, yerna aya izmer ad yerr ifassen neɣ iḍaren-is d azeggaɣ cwiṭ s wakud.

week40.0: Aqcic yewjed mliḥ yerna yewjed ad d-yettwaleḍ. Wass n tlalit d ukayad: aṭas n tlalin ttilint deg wussan i yezzin, send neɣ deffir.
week40.3: Ṛǧu tilɣa n tlalit (tisidmin n yimudar, tuffɣa n waman) d ayen imatu deg tallit-a.
week40.4: Tuffɣa cwiṭ ɣef wass n tlalit tezga d ayen imatu yerna ur yeεni ara dima ilaq ad yili uguren; ittunefk askaddab ugar s umata.

week41.0: Aqcic yezga yewjed mliḥ. Deffir wass n tlalit, askaddab ugar yettunefk s umata akken ad ttwasenqed ṣṣaḥa n uqcic.
week41.1: Uṛǧu yeṭṭawen yezmer ad d-yeddu d usexsi d lbɣi n lweqt ugar.
week41.2: Tuffɣa ɣef wakud n tlalit s umata tettawi ɣer askaddab ugar sɣur tarbaɛt tamedyant.
